text: Skip to main content About Form 6252, Installment Sale Income More In Forms and Instructions Current year Prior year Accessible eBooks Browser-friendly forms and publications Mobile-friendly forms Post release changes to forms Order forms and publications Help with forms and instructions Comment on tax forms and publications Use this form to report income from an installment sale on the installment method. Generally, an installment sale is a disposition of property where at least one payment is received after the end of the tax year in which the disposition occurs.
